# Yeti Expeditions

> Small-group Himalayan trekking operator across Nepal and the Indian Himalaya (Uttarakhand, Himachal/Kinnaur, Ladakh, West Bengal). Founded and led by working mountain professionals — not a booking platform reselling other operators' trips. Philosophy: help each trekker find the right journey for them, rather than sell a fixed itinerary to everyone.

## About

Yeti Expeditions is a Himalayan trekking company built by the guides who lead the treks, not around them. It was founded by Pradhuman Singh Negi — an ex-Indian Army commando and instructor at the High Altitude Warfare School and Siachen Battle School — together with Nitin (returning from a corporate career) and Gurdit (a trainer of trainers from Nepal's trekking corridors). Every lead guide on the roster is a partner in the business, not a hire.

Headquarters: Space Jam, Third Floor, Sector 34, Chandigarh 160022, India
Operating regions: Nepal (Khumbu, Annapurna, Manaslu) and the Indian Himalaya (Uttarakhand, Kinnaur/Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, West Bengal)

## Founder

**Pradhuman Singh Negi** — Expedition Director & Co-Founder
- Ex-Indian Army commando; instructor at the High Altitude Warfare School (HAWS), Gulmarg — instructors there are known as "White Devils"
- Instructor at the Siachen Battle School (SBS), the highest battlefield on Earth
- Mountain skiing instructor at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Mountaineering and Allied Sports (ABVIMAS), Manali — trained over 10,000 students across 8 years
- Avalanche rescue-trained and certified at the Air Zermatt Training Center, Switzerland
- Currently leads a ~40-person rescue team with Tiranga Mountain Rescue (TMR), training Indian Army posts in avalanche detection and avoidance through winter
- Officially recognised by India's Defence Minister, Rajnath Singh, in 2022 for snow and avalanche rescue efforts in Arunachal Pradesh
- President of the Kinnaur Mountaineering Association

- Difficulty: Difficult | Group size: Max 12 | Season: Mar–May, Oct–Nov
- From $1,500 USD | Accommodation: Teahouse

- Accommodation: Teahouse

Custom and private departures are available on all routes for groups that want their own dates, pace or itinerary — not only the fixed departures listed above.

## Safety Standards

- Lead guides are WFR / NOLS or MOI mountaineering certified
- Blood oxygen (SpO2) and pulse monitoring for acclimatisation
- Itineraries are designed with appropriate altitude gain and built-in acclimatisation, not compressed for speed

## Community & Rescue Work

Yeti Expeditions' team is active in mountain safety training beyond guided treks:
- Trained 11 rescuers of the State Disaster Relief Force (SDRF), in association with the Kinnaur Mountaineering, Skiing & Rescue Association, on a summit expedition to Sangla Kanda Peak (16,469 ft), Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh
- Ran joint rescue-readiness training with Kinnaur Police and Himachal Home Guard (40 personnel) at Escape Camp, Rakchham Village, Kinnaur

## Cancellation Policy

**India treks:**
- More than 45 days before departure: 10% cancellation charge
- 30–45 days before: 60% refund
- 16–29 days before: 45% refund
- 0–15 days before: no refund

**Nepal treks:**
- More than 45 days before departure: 10% cancellation charge
- 20–45 days before: 45% refund
- 0–19 days before: no refund

Cancellations must be submitted by email or WhatsApp (not verbal). Refunds are typically processed within 6–7 working days. For fixed departures with fewer than 5 confirmed trekkers, Yeti Expeditions does not cancel the trek — a small additional cost may apply instead.
